name: w3c-wot
label: W3C WoT (IoT)
description: Web of Things Thing Description — IoT device interoperability

table_notes.wot_thing: Root registry of every physical or virtual IoT device; security definitions and JSON-LD context are stored as JSONB alongside the geographic location.
table_notes.wot_property: Describes a readable/writable data point exposed by a Thing (e.g. temperature, switch state) including its data type, unit, and access forms.
table_notes.wot_property_value: Time-series observation store for property readings; typed columns (numeric, text, bool, json) accommodate all WoT data types in one table.
table_notes.wot_action: Defines an invocable operation on a Thing (e.g. reboot, set-brightness) with JSON Schema for request input and response output.
table_notes.wot_event: Describes an asynchronous notification a Thing can emit (e.g. threshold-exceeded, door-opened) with its payload schema.
table_notes.wot_event_log: Append-only record of every event emission from any Thing; high-volume table suited for partitioning by occurred_at.

wot_thing.name: id
wot_thing.description: Stable device identifier; used as FK target in all child tables

wot_thing.name: title
wot_thing.description: Human-readable name of the Thing as specified in its Thing Description

wot_thing.name: description
wot_thing.description: Free-text description of the device's purpose and capabilities

wot_thing.name: base_url
wot_thing.description: Base URL prepended to all relative form hrefs in the Thing Description

wot_thing.name: manufacturer
wot_thing.description: Name of the company or person that manufactured or deployed this device

wot_thing.name: model
wot_thing.description: Model identifier or product name assigned by the manufacturer

wot_thing.name: serial_number
wot_thing.description: Unique serial number assigned to this physical device unit

wot_thing.name: firmware_version
wot_thing.description: Currently running firmware version string for compatibility tracking

wot_thing.name: support_url
wot_thing.description: URL to documentation or support resources for this device model

wot_thing.name: location
wot_thing.description: WGS84 physical location of the device; enables ST_DWithin proximity queries

wot_thing.name: registered_at
wot_thing.description: Timestamp when the device was first registered in this platform

wot_thing.name: last_seen_at
wot_thing.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful communication with this device

wot_thing.name: is_online
wot_thing.description: Current connectivity status; updated by the health-check or heartbeat mechanism

wot_thing.name: context
wot_thing.description: JSON-LD @context array/object mapping semantic vocabularies to namespace URIs

wot_property.name: id
wot_property.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key; referenced by wot_property_value.property_id

wot_property.name: thing_id
wot_property.description: Device that exposes this property; references wot_thing.id

wot_property.name: name
wot_property.description: Machine-readable property name used in protocol interactions (e.g. temperature)

wot_property.name: title
wot_property.description: Human-readable label for display in UIs (e.g. Ambient Temperature)

wot_property.name: description
wot_property.description: Detailed explanation of what this property measures or controls

wot_property.name: type
wot_property.description: JSON Schema data type of the property value (number, string, boolean, object, array)

wot_property.name: unit
wot_property.description: Physical unit of measurement (e.g. Celsius, lux, Pascal); preferably OM2 or QUDT URI

wot_property.name: minimum
wot_property.description: Minimum valid numeric value for range validation

wot_property.name: maximum
wot_property.description: Maximum valid numeric value for range validation

wot_property.name: read_only
wot_property.description: True if clients can only read this property and not write to it

wot_property.name: observable
wot_property.description: True if the device supports push notifications (SSE/WebSocket) when the value changes

wot_property.name: forms
wot_property.description: WoT interaction affordance forms array ({"href", "op", "contentType"}) describing protocol bindings

wot_property_value.name: id
wot_property_value.description: Monotonically increasing surrogate key for time-series ordering

wot_property_value.name: property_id
wot_property_value.description: Which property this reading belongs to; references wot_property.id

wot_property_value.name: value_numeric
wot_property_value.description: Observation value when the property type is number or integer

wot_property_value.name: value_text
wot_property_value.description: Observation value when the property type is string or enum

wot_property_value.name: value_bool
wot_property_value.description: Observation value when the property type is boolean

wot_property_value.name: value_json
wot_property_value.description: Observation value when the property type is object or array (arbitrary nested structure)

wot_property_value.name: recorded_at
wot_property_value.description: Wall-clock time when this reading was persisted; use as the time-series partition key

wot_property_value.name: quality
wot_property_value.description: OPC-UA-style data quality flag: GOOD, UNCERTAIN, BAD, or MISSING

wot_action.name: id
wot_action.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for this action definition

wot_action.name: thing_id
wot_action.description: Device that exposes this action; references wot_thing.id

wot_action.name: name
wot_action.description: Machine-readable action name used in protocol bindings (e.g. reboot, setBrightness)

wot_action.name: title
wot_action.description: Human-readable label for UIs (e.g. Reboot Device, Set Brightness)

wot_action.name: description
wot_action.description: Detailed description of what the action does and any side effects

wot_action.name: input_schema
wot_action.description: JSON Schema object describing the action request body structure and constraints

wot_action.name: output_schema
wot_action.description: JSON Schema object describing the action response payload structure

wot_action.name: forms
wot_action.description: WoT interaction affordance forms array ({"href", "op", "contentType"}) describing protocol endpoints

wot_event.name: id
wot_event.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key; referenced by wot_event_log.event_id

wot_event.name: thing_id
wot_event.description: Device that can emit this event type; references wot_thing.id

wot_event.name: name
wot_event.description: Machine-readable event name used in subscription forms (e.g. overheating, motionDetected)

wot_event.name: title
wot_event.description: Human-readable label for the event type (e.g. Overheating Alert)

wot_event.name: description
wot_event.description: Explanation of what condition triggers this event and its significance

wot_event.name: data_schema
wot_event.description: JSON Schema object describing the structure of the event payload data field

wot_event.name: forms
wot_event.description: WoT subscription forms array ({"href", "op": "subscribeevent", "contentType"}) for consumers

wot_event_log.name: id
wot_event_log.description: Monotonically increasing surrogate key for append-only event ordering

wot_event_log.name: event_id
wot_event_log.description: Event type that was emitted; references wot_event.id

wot_event_log.name: payload_data
wot_event_log.description: Actual payload of this event emission; structure matches wot_event.data_schema

wot_event_log.name: occurred_at
wot_event_log.description: Timestamp when the device emitted this event; recommended partition key for large deployments
